test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 87.5°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 2 ∶ 3, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
solution:
**Given**

∠STR = 87.5°.

The bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T

The ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 2 ∶ 3

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd361e24cb54aa2c7406ab284d943597339ee12e81993afbb92bb2b02f51e1a2.png] 

∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360

∠P + ∠Q = 360 - (∠R + ∠S) ..(1)

&a
